The supplier is requested to register the labels/stickers of the above brands under AP Excise Act and Rules made there under duly following the procedure prescribed there in. The supplier shall submit all the required documents as per the Prohibition of Excise rules for registering the labels/stickers to the Commissioner of Proh. & Excise, AP Amaravathi. The supplier is permitted to supply the registered Beer brands as per the Basic Price and MRP's communicated during the period of Rate Contract Agreement or until further orders as per the terms and conditions of Rate Contract Agreement at reference 1st cited, The 'Order for supply' will be issued only on approval of the label and entering into Rate Contract Agreement. If the supplier fails to submit approved stickers/labels or other documents within (6) months all such labels shall be deemed to have been lapsed.
